item.title: 'It’s so stupid it hurts': Candace Owens blasts CIA narrative after Charlie Kirk assassination sparks fresh public outrage
item.description: Candace Owens has renewed her criticism of the CIA and rejected official claims in the Charlie Kirk killing. In a January 3, 2026 post on X, she called the investigation a failure. item.title: Twitch streamer Swifty unbanned after brief suspension, thanks fans for support
item.description: Veteran Twitch streamer Swifty is back online after a surprising temporary ban that halted his 14-year career. The World of Warcraft personality was suspended following IRL food delivery streams, intended to boost income during slow ad revenue months. Community support and rapid appeals led to his swift unbanning, much to the relief of his dedicated fanbase.

item.title: Pentagon censuring, possibly demoting US senator over 'seditious' video
item.description: The Pentagon has issued a letter of censure to Democratic Senator Mark Kelly and may reduce his military rank in retirement over a video urging US personnel to refuse illegal orders, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Monday. "Kelly -- and five other members of Congress -- released a reckless and seditious video that was clearly intended to undermine good order and military discipline," Hegseth said in a post on X. In response to the November video and other statements, the Pentagon opened proceedings that could see Kelly's retired rank reduced, said Hegseth, who has also "issued a formal Letter of Censure, which outlines the totality of Captain (for now) Kelly's reckless misconduct."

item.title: 'Next year this will happen': Peruvian shamans' prediction on Trump and Maduro shockingly comes true
item.description: Peruvian shamans' annual predictions have gained attention as one eerily came true. They foretold the downfall of Nicolas Maduro, who was reportedly removed from power. This event aligns with their ritualistic forecasts. Other predictions include Donald Trump falling seriously ill and the end of the Russia-Ukraine conflict. The shamans' accurate prediction marks a rare success for their forecasts.

item.title: 'If they had listened to me': Trump repeats claim he predicted Bin Laden and warned about 9/11 a year earlier
item.description: Donald Trump is again falsely claiming he predicted the 9/11 attacks and that thousands of lives could have been saved if he had been heeded. He stated this on Air Force One, asserting his 2000 book warned of Osama bin Laden. Fact checks, however, show bin Laden was mentioned only once as a minor figure.

item.title: Megyn Kelly net worth: How podcast success and major TV deals built her media fortune
item.description: Megyn Kelly, a prominent media figure, has amassed a $45 million net worth through lucrative deals at Fox News and NBC, alongside her successful podcast, bestselling book, and high-profile speaking engagements. Despite leaving network television, she maintains strong earnings by controlling her own platforms, demonstrating enduring influence in the media landscape.

item.title: Mercer Steps Down As Dungeon Master: Mulligan takes over Campaign Four; Mercer stays as CCO
item.description: Matthew Mercer has stepped back from leading Critical Role’s “Dungeons and Dragons” livestream after opening up about burnout and creative exhaustion. While he remains involved in major projects like animated series and game publishing, Brennan Lee Mulligan now serves as game master for Campaign Four. Mercer says taking time away is essential for long-term creativity, balance, and renewed inspiration.

item.title: Who is William DeFoor? 'Crazy' man arrested for attacking JD Vance's home
item.description: Vice President JD Vance's Cincinnati home and vehicle were vandalized early Monday by a man wielding a hammer. A Secret Service agent witnessed the incident and apprehended the suspect, identified as William DeFoor. Vance and his family were not present during the attack. DeFoor has a prior vandalism conviction.
